arxiv-2012-06849.title: Approximate Generalized Additive-Quadratic Functional Equations on Ternary Banach Algebras
arxiv-2012-06849.creator: Sedigheh Jahedi
arxiv-2012-06849.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we introduce the concept of j-hom-derivation, j\in\{1,2\} and solve the new generalized additive-quadratic functional equations in the sense of ternary Banach algebras. Moreover, using the fixed point method, we prove its Hyers-Ulam stability. Keywords: Hyers-Ulam stability, ternary Banach algebra, additive function, quadratic function, fixed point theorem. Mathematics Subject Classification (2010): 17A40, 39B52, 17B40, 47B47.

arxiv-2202-11062.title: The Relative Heat Content for Submanifolds in Sub-Riemannian Geometry
arxiv-2202-11062.creator: Tommaso Rossi
arxiv-2202-11062.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tommaso Rossi. We study the small-time asymptotics of the relative heat content for submanifolds in sub-Riemannian geometry. First, we prove the existence of a smooth tubular neighborhood for submanifolds of any codimension, assuming they do not have characteristic points. Next, we propose a definition of relative heat content for submanifolds of codimension k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 and we build an approximation of this quantity, via smooth tubular neighborhoods.

arxiv-2206-01751.title: Grand Unification of continuous-variable codes
arxiv-2206-01751.creator: Allan D. C. Tosta, Thiago O. Maciel, Leandro Aolita
arxiv-2206-01751.description: Abstract Quantum error correction codes in continuous variables (also called CV codes, or single-mode bosonic codes) have recently been identified to be a technologically viable option for building fault-tolerant quantum computers. The best known examples are the GKP code and the cat-code, both of which were shown to have some advantageous properties over any discrete-variable, or qubit codes.

arxiv-2206-05009.title: Weighted Ensembles for Active Learning with Adaptivity
arxiv-2206-05009.creator: Konstantinos D. Polyzos, Qin Lu, Georgios B. Giannakis
arxiv-2206-05009.description: Abstract Labeled data can be expensive to acquire in several application domains, including medical imaging, robotics, and computer vision. To efficiently train machine learning models under such high labeling costs, active learning (AL) judiciously selects the most informative data instances to label on-the-fly.

arxiv-2211-06426.title: Clustering of countries based on the associated social contact patterns in epidemiological modelling
arxiv-2211-06426.creator: Evans Kiptoo Korir, Zsolt Vizi
arxiv-2211-06426.description: Abstract Mathematical models have been used to understand the spread patterns of infectious diseases such as Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19). The transmission component of the models can be modelled in an age-dependent manner via introducing contact matrix for the population, which describes the contact rates between the age groups.

arxiv-2310-02668.title: Gauss curvature flow with shrinking obstacle
arxiv-2310-02668.creator: Ki-Ahm Lee, Taehun Lee
arxiv-2310-02668.description: Abstract . We consider a flow by powers of Gauss curvature under the obstruction that the flow cannot penetrate a prescribed region, so called an obstacle. For all dimensions and positive powers, we prove the optimal curvature bounds of solutions and all time existence with its long time behavior.

arxiv-2406-14867.title: Investigating the Transferability of Code Repair for Low-Resource Programming Languages
arxiv-2406-14867.creator: Kyle Wong, Alfonso Amayuelas, Liangming Pan, William Yang Wang
arxiv-2406-14867.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kyle Wong, Alfonso Amayuelas, Liangming Pan, William Yang Wang. Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance on code generation tasks. A recent use case is iterative code repair, where an LLM fixes an incorrect program by rationalizing about errors and generating new code. Recent works augment the code repair process by integrating modern techniques such as chain-of-thought reasoning or distillation, but only study their benefits on high-resource languages like Python, and ignore low-resource languages like Perl.

arxiv-2502-05626.title: Box Singularity Conditions in Box Diagrams of Decay Processes
arxiv-2502-05626.creator: Chao-Wei Shen, Ming-Yang Duan, Jia-Jun Wu
arxiv-2502-05626.description: Abstract Since 1959, singularities within single-loop diagrams have been studied. They are believed to significantly influence our understanding of experimental observables. In this study, we explore the singularities that arise from box diagrams in the decay process, which can be classified into two distinct categories.

arxiv-2504-07330.title: Advancing Multi-Secant Quasi-Newton Methods for General Convex Functions
arxiv-2504-07330.creator: Mokhwa Lee, Yifan Sun
arxiv-2504-07330.description: Abstract Quasi-Newton (QN) methods provide an efficient alternative to second-order methods for minimizing smooth unconstrained problems. While QN methods generally compose a Hessian estimate based on one secant interpolation per iteration, multisecant methods use multiple secant interpolations and can improve the quality of the Hessian estimate at small additional overhead cost.

arxiv-2507-23641.title: Polynomial Lattices for the BIKE Cryptosystem
arxiv-2507-23641.creator: Michael Schaller
arxiv-2507-23641.description: Abstract In this paper we introduce a rank 2 2 lattice over a polynomial ring arising from the public key of the BIKE cryptosystem [ 1 ] . The secret key is a sparse vector in this lattice. We study properties of this lattice and generalize the recovery of weak keys from [ 3 ] .

arxiv-2511-18541.title: Probing CP-violating Higgs-Gauge couplings with Higgsstrahlung at e − ​ e + e^{-}e^{+} collider
arxiv-2511-18541.creator: Amir Subba, Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Abhik Sarkar
arxiv-2511-18541.description: Abstract We investigate the sensitivity of a future high-luminosity e − ​ e + e^{-}e^{+} collider operating at s = 250 ​ GeV \sqrt{s}=250~\text{GeV} to CP-violating and CP-conserving anomalous h ​ V ​ V hVV interactions via the Higgsstrahlung process.

pmc-11530906.creator: Luis A. Rubio
pmc-11530906.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). CAS was formulated to contain the same amount of protein (190 g kg−1) as a commercial Maize-soy diet which was used as a practical reference.

pmc-11546958.title: Highly Robust, Pressureless Silver Sinter-Bonding Technology Using PMMA Combustion for Power Semiconductor Applications
pmc-11546958.creator: Moses Gu, Hyunjin Nam, Sehoon Park, Minkyung Shin, Sung-Hoon Choa
pmc-11546958.description: This study presents the development of a highly robust, pressureless, and void-free silver sinter-bonding technology for power semiconductor packaging. A bimodal silver paste containing silver nanoparticles and sub-micron particles was used, with polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) as an additive to provide additional thermal energy during sintering. This enabled rapid sintering and the formation of a dense, void-free bonding joint.

pmc-12631176.title: TGF-β1/SMAD3-mediated Non-canonical Hedgehog Signaling Promotes Pancreatic Stellate Cell Activation and Fibrosis in Chronic Pancreatitis

pmc-12631176.description: Excessive Hedgehog (Hh) signaling activity contributes to fibrosis in multiple organs. We show that GLI2 is one of the top-ranked effectors in the pancreas of CP patients and is highly expressed in activated PSCs.

pmc-13000377.title: AI Triage in Primary Care: Building Safer and More Equitable Real-World Evidence
pmc-13000377.creator: Aymn Alamoudi, Evangelos Kontopantelis, Salwa S Zghebi, Benjamin Brown, Amaryllis Mavragani, K M Sajjadul Islam, Mohammad Kokash, John Grosser, Ke Chen
